title: Frontex drones helped Libya and Tunisia forcibly return at least 33,000 people in the central Mediterranean
lede: The EU's border agency Frontex is instrumental in helping Libya and Tunisia intercept migrants in distress. A new study reveals the extent of those Frontex-assisted interceptions, totalling some 33,000 between 2018 and 2024.
